./bootstrap
./configure
make "-j$(nproc)"

for fuzzer in $SRC/*_fuzzer.c; do
  fuzzer_basename=$(basename -s .c $fuzzer)

  $CC $CFLAGS \
      -I $SRC -Iinclude \
      -c $fuzzer -o $fuzzer_basename.o

  $CXX $CXXFLAGS \
      -std=c++11 \
      $fuzzer_basename.o \
      -o $OUT/$fuzzer_basename \
      $LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE \
      src/.libs/libyaml.a

## Run `./bootstrap` to generate the "Makefile.in" files in this directory and
## the "$SUBDIRS" subdirectories.

SUBDIRS = include src . tests
